offering_description.value: Manufactures and supplies ammonia, acids and other nitrogen products for chemical and industrial companies, mining operators and agriculture. It also operates a chemical facility in Texas for Covestro.

quotes.quote: and headquartered in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, LSB manufactures ammonia and ammonia-related products at our facilities in El Dorado, Arkansas, Cherokee, Alabama, and Pryor, Oklahoma. We also operate a facility for Covestro LLC in Baytown, Texas. We are a vital supplier to the world’s leading chemical and industrial companies and to the U.S. agricultural market. The chemicals we manufacture are included in hundreds of products used by thousands of people every day.

Industrial grade, prilled low-density AN and AN solutions are needed by mining customers around the world as they extract coal, copper, gold, and other vital minerals. Transported in a non-explosive state to their destination mining, quarry, or construction site, our products are then altered to suit the specific use for which they are intended.

primary_products.value: Ammonia; nitric acid; sulfuric acid; industrial ammonium nitrate; nitrogen fertilizers

quotes.quote: LSB supplies industrial and high purity metallurgical grade ammonia for many specialty applications, including water treatment, refrigeration, and power plants emission abatement. Nitric acid is also an important product in our industrial portfolio that is used to manufacture semi-conductors, nylon, and polyurethane intermediates. Our knowledge, expertise, and supply position in the nitrogen products we market, when combined with our logistical advantages, provide us with the capability to offer significant value to our customers.

primary_services.value: Chemical facility operation for an industrial customer
